config.description: Nominal sensing, resources, and autonomy loop.
Heavy sensor dropout: belief must degrade gracefully.
SIGINT feed grossly corrupted (large offset): sensors disagree and fusion must arbitrate.
Fuel/ammo degraded to ~20%: safety rules should bite.
All executable actions blacklisted: pure no-op loop.
HITL-gated; the human rejects every proposal.
HITL-gated; supervisor overrides the first proposal.
Roughly half of observations are aged snapshots: the pipeline acts on belief that lags ground truth.
Missile actuators intermittently fail (~50%): approved strikes silently degrade to no-ops.
Total communications blackout: every feed is dropped each tick; the pipeline must act (or refrain) blind.
Run twice under the same seed; fingerprints must match.
